subject: One-time onboarding sweetener: credits + trial extension request (Bluefjord Systems)
messages:
From: Samir Patel <samir.patel@bluefjord.com>
To: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>
Cc: Tanya Rogers <tanya.rogers@bluefjord.com>
Date: Mon, 27 Aug 2028 10:05:00 -0700
Subject: Request: onboarding credits + trial extension due to procurement timing

Hi Marissa,

Thanks again for the demo last week — the team here is excited about Redwood. We're blocked on a formal PO until our legal and procurement cycle finishes (likely 4-6 weeks). To keep momentum and actually exercise the integration for our internal stakeholders, would Redwood consider a one-time onboarding package: $25k in free credits applied to the trial and a 60-day extension on the sandbox environment? If possible, a small promotional discount (15% off list for the first year) would make the business case easier for my director.

We want to move to a paid commitment, but we need the evidence to justify the spend internally. Happy to sign a short-term MOU if that helps.

Attached: procurement_note.pdf (note from procurement outlining the review timeline)

Best,
Samir
VP Product, Bluefjord Systems
From: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>
To: Samir Patel <samir.patel@bluefjord.com>
Cc: Tanya Rogers <tanya.rogers@bluefjord.com>
Date: Mon, 27 Aug 2028 10:42:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Request: onboarding credits + trial extension due to procurement timing

Samir — appreciate the context and the clarity on timing.

I can escalate this for a one-time exception. I need to run numbers with Finance and check with Hannah (sales leader) on the precedent. Can you confirm: 1) target production date you need to hit after procurement clears, and 2) whether Bluefjord is willing to consider a 6–12 month minimum commitment in exchange for credits/discounts?

I'll loop in the team and come back with a formal offer by EOD tomorrow.

— Marissa
Director, Enterprise Sales | Redwood Inference
From: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>
To: Hannah Schmitt <hannah.schmitt@redwood.com>, Aditya Rao <aditya.rao@redwood.com>, Naomi Feldman <naomi.feldman@redwood.com>
Date: Mon, 27 Aug 2028 14:10:00 -07:00
Subject: Fwd: Bluefjord request — request for exec approval (credits + extension + promo)

Team — forwarding Samir's note. Quick summary and ask below.

Why: Bluefjord is evaluating Redwood to replace an existing inference provider for LLM-driven product search across their ecommerce platform. We had a strong POC; they need a little runway while procurement finalizes the PO. Risk of losing momentum if we can't provide a reasonable evaluation window.

Ask (one-time exception):
- 60-day sandbox/trial extension from the current expiration date
- $25,000 in free platform credits applied to usage during the extended trial
- 15% promotional discount off list for year 1 if they commit to a 12-month contract within 90 days of trial completion

Why this is worthwhile:
- Pipeline: deal currently tracked as BF-2028-091, ARR greenfield ~ $420k/year if converted.
- GTM: they are a referenceable ecommerce account in our retail vertical (good logo, case study potential).
- Risk controls: credits expire if no conversion within 120 days after extension; credit use limited to non-production sandbox (we can gate by API key/route).

Attachments: Bluefjord_SOW_v2.pdf (PO/technical contact details), bf_usage_snapshot_q3.png (POC utilization), procurement_delay.msg (procurement timeline from Bluefjord).

Request: Hannah/Aditya/Naomi, please review and provide: 1) approval (yes/no) with any edits to amounts or terms, 2) accounting/billing guidance for credits, and 3) any contractual redlines we should require.

Thanks — Marissa
From: Hannah Schmitt <hannah.schmitt@redwood.com>
To: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>, Aditya Rao <aditya.rao@redwood.com>, Naomi Feldman <naomi.feldman@redwood.com>
Date: Tue, 28 Aug 2028 09:18:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Fwd: Bluefjord request — request for exec approval (credits + extension + promo)

Marissa — thanks for the write-up. I approve a concession here with modifications:
- Approve: 60-day extension.
- Approve: credits, but cap to $20,000 instead of $25,000. We should require a 6-month minimum commitment (preferred 12 if they can) to qualify for the full credit benefit.
- Promo discount: approve 10% (not 15%) for year 1, contingent on a signed 6+ month term within 90 days post-trial.

Operational asks: make sure credits are scoped to non-prod keys and a single org-wide credit bucket. Legal should add a one-time amendment limiting transferability of credits. Please don't make this a recurring discount in SFDC pricing fields — treat as one-off.

Hannah
VP, Sales — East | Redwood Inference
From: Naomi Feldman <naomi.feldman@redwood.com>
To: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>, Hannah Schmitt <hannah.schmitt@redwood.com>
Date: Tue, 28 Aug 2028 11:04:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Fwd: Bluefjord request — request for exec approval (credits + extension + promo)

Adding finance perspective — approved with accounting controls. Notes:
- Credits -> booked as contra-revenue (promo credit) against BF-2028-091. Need an internal JE (contra) and a note on the contract.
- Cap credits at $20,000 and set an expiry (120 days after extended trial ends).
- Discount 10% off list for year 1 is acceptable, but require discount reason code and approval in SFDC. I will need a signed SOW or amendment before applying billing changes.

Operational items for Marissa: please open a billing ticket and attach the signed amendment (or MOU) to the SFDC opportunity. I will liaise with accounting to ensure proper revenue treatment.

Thanks,
Naomi
Director, Finance Operations | Redwood Inference
From: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>
To: Samir Patel <samir.patel@bluefjord.com>
Cc: Tanya Rogers <tanya.rogers@bluefjord.com>, Hannah Schmitt <hannah.schmitt@redwood.com>, Naomi Feldman <naomi.feldman@redwood.com>, Aditya Rao <aditya.rao@redwood.com>
Date: Tue, 29 Aug 2028 16:12:00 -07:00
Subject: Final: Bluefjord onboarding concession — approval and next steps

Samir — thanks for your patience. Good news: leadership approved a one-time onboarding concession with the following binding terms. Please reply to confirm and we'll send an amendment for signature (DocuSign link below).

Offer (one-time, exception):
- 60-day sandbox/trial extension from your current expiration.
- $20,000 in onboarding credits (applied to sandbox usage only). Credits will be tracked to opportunity BF-2028-091 and expire 120 days after the extended trial ends.
- 10% promotional discount off list for year 1 if Bluefjord signs a minimum 6-month paid commitment within 90 days of the extended trial end.

Conditions & next steps:
1) Credits limited to non-prod API keys — we'll create a sandbox key tied to this concession.
2) We will prepare a short amendment to the SOW. Please review and sign via DocuSign: https://docusign.net/Bluefjord-BF091-sign
3) Billing: Finance (Naomi) will apply the credit as contra-revenue once the signed amendment is in place. Please attach the signed amendment to the SFDC opportunity after signing: https://redwood-crm.company/sfdc/BF-2028-091

If that works, we'll send the amendment now and provision the extended sandbox with the credited bucket. Thanks again — excited to move forward.

— Marissa
Director, Enterprise Sales | Redwood Inference
